note: Howard County NE publishes its official zoning map and the seven village zoning maps only as PDF/image files. The county's GIS entry point is the gWorks property search (howard.gworks.com), which is not a public zoning-district service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online, the county site, NebraskaMap and nearby Grand Island/Hall County GIS found no queryable zoning district polygon layer for Howard County or its towns.
